title_en: 32 PARKING SPOTS FOR SALE ON JORDAN MISJA STREET NEAR SPAK!!!
description_en: 32 parking spaces for sale on Jordan Misja street. The parking spaces are underground in a new building near the spa. The parking spaces are located in -1 and -2. The parking spaces come in different sizes, starting from 20m2 to 56m2. The price also includes the sale of the business, which is currently an hourly parking lot.
